Anastasia Dețiuc (born 14 December 1998) is a Czech-Moldovan tennis player. She has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 72, achieved 25 September 2023. On the ITF Junior Circuit , she had a career-high combined ranking of 22, achieved January 2016. Career [ edit ] Playing for Moldova Fed Cup team (until 2018), Dețiuc has a win–loss record of 3–1. In February 2018, she switched nationalities to represent the Czech Republic . 2022 [ edit ] Partnering Miriam Kolodziejová , Dețiuc won her first WTA Tour doubles title at the Emilia-Romagna Open , defeating Arantxa Rus and Tamara Zidanšek in the final.
